name: Iron Grace
look: a Shaymin sealed in a glass dome: green moss over its back, a pink band, a great pink Gracidea flower among leaves, a dark visor face with pink pixel eyes and a white body on four pink-striped legs
entry: A Pokémon resembling Shaymin, recorded in a report about a sealed garden that walked out of a flower field at night. Inside its dome, the air is always that of a spring morning.
how: Wild: very rare at night in flower forests.
